data.name: EnableChildRows_Description
data.value: Show a separate, lazily loaded child grid beneath each expanded record.

data.name: ChildParentLookup_Description
data.value: Logical name of the self-referencing parent lookup, for example cm_parenttemplateoption.

data.name: ChildViewId_Description
data.value: GUID of a public view of the same table, including the grid columns. Use a view that includes children, not one restricted to top-level records.

data.name: DrivenGrid_Description
data.value: A model-driven dataset grid with column filters, sorting, inline editing and infinite scrolling.

data.name: FilteredRecordCount_Desc
data.value: The number of records after filtering

data.name: HighlightValue_Desc
data.value: The value to indicate a row should be highlighted

data.name: HighlightColor_Desc
data.value: The color to highlight a row using

data.name: EnableLookupLinks_Desc
data.value: When enabled, lookup column values render as links that open the related record.

data.name: EnableInlineEdit_Desc
data.value: When enabled, double-click editable cells to update values directly in the grid.

data.name: LookupFilterConfig_Desc
data.value: Optional JSON lookup filters. Format: {"default":"statecode eq 0","byEntity":{"account":"statecode eq 0"},"byColumn":{"cm_component":"statecode eq 0"},"byColumnAndEntity":{"cm_component@account":"statecode eq 0"}}. If not JSON, value is used as a global OData filter clause.

data.name: LookupFilterConfig2_Desc
data.value: Optional continuation of Lookup Filter Config JSON text.

data.name: LookupFilterConfig3_Desc
data.value: Optional continuation of Lookup Filter Config JSON text.

data.name: LookupFilterConfig4_Desc
data.value: Optional continuation of Lookup Filter Config JSON text.

data.name: LookupFilterConfig5_Desc
data.value: Optional continuation of Lookup Filter Config JSON text.

data.name: HighlightIndicator_Desc
data.value: Set to the name of the field to compare against the Highlight Value

data.name: MaxRows_Desc
data.value: Optional page size for dataset queries. Example: 50. Leave empty to use platform default.

data.name: InfiniteScroll_Desc
data.value: Load the next dataset page automatically as the user reaches the end of the grid. Enabled by default.

data.name: SubGridHeight_Disp
data.value: Sub Grid Height (blank for full tab)

data.name: SubGridHeight_Desc
data.value: Optional fallback height in pixels for an embedded subgrid. Leave blank when using Expand first component to full tab. A positive height supplied by Power Apps takes precedence.

data.name: DisableChildEditing_Description
data.value: Disable child cell editing without disabling parent editing. This does not change Dataverse permissions or native command rules.

data.name: EnableChildCommands_Description
data.value: Retained for existing form compatibility. Does not display buttons inside child panels. Configure native child selection separately.

data.name: EnableNativeChildSelection_Description
data.value: Load selected children into the native host dataset before enabling its commands. Requires a dedicated view that includes both roots and children, with the same parent relationship scope. Do not use a parent-only view.

data.name: ChildContextLookup_Description
data.value: Optional simple lookup to inherit from the parent when adding children, such as cm_itemtemplate. Must differ from the parent-option lookup.

data.name: EnableGrouping_Description
data.value: Group the complete filtered level. Requires infinite scrolling.

data.name: EnableAggregation_Description
data.value: Calculate complete-level sum, average, minimum and maximum. Requires infinite scrolling.

data.name: EnableColumnMoving_Description
data.value: Allow drag-and-drop and menu-based column moving.

data.name: EnableMultipleSelection_Description
data.value: Allow more than one selected row, up to the Dynamics selection limit.

data.name: EnableRangeSelection_Description
data.value: Allow rectangular cell selection and copying to Excel.

data.name: EnableFiltering_Description
data.value: Allow users to apply grid column filters.

data.name: EnableSorting_Description
data.value: Allow users to change grid column sorting.

data.name: ShowTypeIcons_Description
data.value: Show an icon identifying the data type in each column header.

data.name: ShowStatusIcons_Description
data.value: Show state and status indicator icons alongside text.

data.name: ShowChoiceColors_Description
data.value: Use the colours supplied by choice metadata, with contrasting text.

data.name: ReflowBehavior_Description
data.value: Use grid, list or auto. Auto uses a compact list below 480 pixels.

data.name: ListColumns_Description
data.value: Number of fields shown per compact list row, from 1 to 10.

data.name: ShowAvatar_Description
data.value: Show an initials avatar in compact list rows. No external image requests.

data.name: ShowListColumnNames_Description
data.value: Show column names in compact list rows.

data.name: BandedListRows_Description
data.value: Use alternate shading in compact list rows.

data.name: EnableJumpBar_Description
data.value: Show A-Z for the primary sorted text column. Keeps other filters; All removes only the alphabet condition.

data.name: RememberColumnLayout_Description
data.value: Remember widths and order in this browser for this user, table and view. No record data or filters are stored.

data.name: NavigationTypes_Description
data.value: Use all, primary or none for lookup links. Enable lookup links must also be enabled.

data.name: EnableLookupDialog_Description
data.value: Add More records to lookup editing using the supported Power Apps lookup dialog. Selected records are checked against configured restrictions before saving.

data.name: EnableComponentAvailability_Description
data.value: Use the entry's saved Calculator, Condition and Result records when searching and saving components. Requires the entry availability form library.

data.name: ShowEmptyChildArrows_Description
data.value: Keep an expand/collapse arrow on every row, including branches with no related records. Off preserves normal leaf-arrow detection.

data.name: FitToRows_Description
data.value: Remove unused space below complete embedded grid results. Expanded rows grow up to the available height, then scroll. Off preserves full-tab fill sizing.
